transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I just... I don't care about anything anymore. I used to do a lot, you know? Art classes, board-game nights with friends, hiking... I even thought about getting back on my old soccer team. But now, I just don't care. I sit in my room all day and just watch everything slip away. It's like I can't find a reason to do any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been a while. Um, it really became constant around the summer. So altogether, it's been about a year and four months of just... feeling like this.
Did this loss of interest begin after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

Yeah, it did. Um... it started shortly after my divorce. Actually, now that I think about the exact timeline, this has been going on for about a year and eleven months now. I know I just said a year and four months a second ago, but I guess the days just kind of blur together. But yeah, it all really began right after the divorce.
Aside from losing interest, have you been feeling depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. Um... most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling right in my chest. It just kind of stays with me all day. It honestly feels like there’s no future for me beyond these apartment walls.
How has your energy been during this period?

It's been really low. Um... honestly, I don't have much energy at all. Even after I've been in bed for half the day, doing something small like taking a shower or just answering one text message... it feels like I've already worked a full shift. I'm just completely drained all the time.
During this period, have there been any stretches of two months or longer when you felt essentially back to your usual self?
No, there haven't been. Um... it's just been a constant weight this whole time. I haven't had any breaks from it where I felt like my normal self again. Not for two months, not even for a few days.
How has your sleep been during this period?

It hasn't been good. Um... I usually lie awake for hours at night. I keep getting up to check the door, just listening. And then... when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I wake up way before dawn. I'll wake up shaking, and I just can't get back to sleep after that.
Have these depressive symptoms been present more days than not for at least two full years?

Two years? Um... I'm not really sure about that exact timeframe. I know it's been a long time, but... I don't know if it's been two full years of feeling like this every single day. I just know it feels like it's been going on forever.
How long ago did these depressive symptoms first begin occurring more days than not?
It really became a constant thing around the summer... like, the summer of last year. So I guess it's been about a year and four months now that it's been happening more days than not.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes. I keep having thoughts that I just don't want to wake up anymore. And... when my friend found me recently, I had actually been saying out loud that I couldn't keep living like this. It's just really hard right now.
